court: In the High Court of Madras
appellants: Edayathimangalam Avibaktha Vaidyanatha Iyer Trust Rep. by its Managing Trustee “Navasuja” .…. Petitioner;
advocates: For Petitioner: Mrs. R. Jayalakshmi for Mr. S. Muthuvenkatraman
For Respondents: Mr. T.C. Gopalakrishnan standing counsel
judgment_text:
Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents to dispose of the petitioner's representation dated 22.11.2018 and 21.02.2019 within the time to be stipulated by this Hon'ble Court.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

K. Ravichandrabaabu, J.:— Mr. T.C. Gopalakrishnan, learned standing counsel takes notice for the respondents. By consent of both the parties, the main writ petition is taken up for final disposal at the admission stage itself.

2. The petitioner is a Trust. In respect of the property owned by the petitioner, the respondent/Corporation enhanced the property tax and issued the demand notice. Raising some objections, the petitioner made two representations dated 22.11.2018 and 21.02.2019. It is stated that those representations are not considered so far. Therefore, the present writ petition is filed seeking for disposal of those representations.

3. The learned standing counsel for the respondent/Corporation submitted that those representations will be considered and appropriate orders will be passed on merits and in accordance with law, within the time stipulated by this Court.

4. Considering the above stated facts and circumstances and without expressing any view on the merits of the claim made by the respective parties, this Writ Petition is disposed of, only by directing the first respondent to consider the representations dated 22.11.2018 and 21.02.2019 and pass orders on the same on merits and in accordance with law, within a period of four weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. Till an order is passed by the first respondent, no coercive steps shall be taken against the petitioner in respect of enhanced tax amount. No costs. Consequently, connected miscellaneous petition is closed.
